name: ICSOE/SISUB cuatrimestral filer and consistency checker for small REPSE contractors
buyer: REPSE-registered specialised-service and works contractors (cleaning, maintenance, construction subcontractors), plus their small client firms that carry joint liability
trigger: LSS art. 15-A (ICSOE, IMSS) and Ley INFONAVIT art. 29 Bis (SISUB), filed every four months (17 Jan, 17 May, 17 Sep). 'No information' filings are also mandatory. Fines are reported as 500-2,000 UMA, with sources inconsistent. REPSE renewal needs positive SAT, IMSS and INFONAVIT opinions. The REPSE portal was updated in Jul 2026.
existing: Competitor search ('software ICSOE SISUB REPSE automatizar informativa cuatrimestral') found no dedicated software. Supply is consultancies (Praxium), training (COFIDE, CONTPAQi-style courses) and the free IMSS/INFONAVIT portals with bulk templates. Payroll suites may already export ICSOE files (not checked).
unchecked: Whether payroll suites (CONTPAQi Nóminas, Aspel, Runa) already generate ICSOE/SISUB templates, the count of active REPSE registrants (tens of thousands claimed in press, not verified), and willingness to pay beyond what bureaus already charge.

first_check.duty: LSS art. 15-A (ICSOE, IMSS): REPSE-registered contractors file a four-monthly information return per contract, due by the 17th of Jan, May and Sep. Penalty: LSS art. 304-A fr. XXII and 304-B fr. V, 500-2,000 UMA. No fine applies if the filer corrects late of their own accord before IMSS acts (art. 304-C). SISUB: Ley INFONAVIT art. 29 Bis, same calendar. Rule texts were seen on the mley.mx and sdv.com.mx compendia, not in the DOF itself.
first_check.market: No official count of active REPSE registrants found. STPS cancelled more than 51,000 REPSE registrations in 2025, and more than 13,000 firms re-registered (Tiempo, 30 Sep 2026). A commercial guide cites more than 71,000 registered by Sep 2021. In 2024 only about 53% of firms due for renewal re-qualified (IDC Online). This suggests tens of thousands of active filers, but the figure is unverified.
first_check.competitor: Free IMSS ICSOE portal with an official bulk CSV template and guide (imss.gob.mx/icsoe). Paid SISUB/ICSOE CSV templates and courses from elconta.mx. Training from COFIDE. Consultancies such as Praxium. No dedicated SaaS found in 4 searches. Whether CONTPAQi Nóminas, Runa or Aspel export ICSOE/SISUB layouts: not verified (no documentation found either way).
first_check.reason: The duty is real and in force. LSS art. 15-A requires REPSE contractors to file the ICSOE every four months, by 17 Jan, 17 May and 17 Sep. Missing or late filing is fined 500-2,000 UMA under LSS art. 304-A XXII and 304-B V. SISUB under Ley INFONAVIT art. 29 Bis follows the same calendar. I found no dedicated software that generates or validates ICSOE/SISUB files. What exists is the free IMSS portal with a bulk CSV template, CSV templates sold by elconta.mx, consultancies and courses. I could not check whether payroll suites (CONTPAQi, Runa) export these files. The market is large: STPS cancelled more than 51k REPSE registrations in 2025. But the free CSV template means low pain, payroll bureaus already absorb the work, and the job is three short filings a year. Willingness to pay is weak.

challenge_check.killer: None found. Partial overlap: BDO's REPSE SaaS module (validates supplier documents, connects to an ERP), Xternall's supplier-monitoring platform, the free IMSS ICSOE bulk CSV template, and accountants or consultancies such as Praxium that file for clients.
challenge_check.reason: I found nothing that kills the idea, but it is weak. Seven Spanish-language searches turned up no dedicated SaaS that builds ICSOE/SISUB files from payroll or SUA data, or checks the two against each other. I also found no documentation either way on export features in CONTPAQi, Aspel NOI or Runa. Runa only publishes a guide. BDO's REPSE SaaS and Xternall serve client firms monitoring their REPSE suppliers, which overlaps with the joint-liability buyers. The free IMSS portal takes bulk CSV uploads of up to 3,000 workers, and the filing happens only three times a year, so willingness to pay is limited. The market is unclear: about 71k firms registered in 2021, about 53% renewed in 2024, and STPS cancelled more than 51k registrations in 2025. A mid-2026 reform eased REPSE registration and renewal. I found no change to ICSOE/SISUB.
